objective: Complete MCP-to-Pi adapter research through public browser sources without requiring Exa credentials.
scope: Read-only research for deferred0.3.4; no implementation now. Prior research failed because pi-web-kit search/fetch says exa provider requires EXA_API_KEY or apiKeys.exa in project or agent-directory pi-web-kit config. This is a missing optional search service, not a denial; use available browser tools on public sources rather than request/change credentials.

User requirement: if there is an mcp-to-pi-tool extension for adapting the context-bloat from mcp to actual pi tools, we should use it if it's well maintained and not obscure, if not we shall develop it as another package pi-mcp-to-tool.

Start with current Pi's @earendil-works/pi-mcp and @earendil-works/pi-codemode: bun.lock lists1.5.0, installed host1.5.2. Check public npm/GitHub/readme/docs for schema loading, native callable Pi tools and codemode lazy discovery. Compare at most2 other credible maintained options if needed.

Cite authoritative URLs, versions and dated maintenance/community evidence, compatibility, supported transports/OS and security behavior. Select established maintained adapter if it solves context bloat; justify new standalone package only if none qualifies. If browser unavailable too, give local package source/document evidence and precise remaining unknowns.
constraints: No installs, source/config writes, logins, account/security changes or token reads/output. Use public browser information only, do not interact with account controls. Do not change global selected root/model or user installation.
Report at most8 bullets with facts/inference/unknown separated; long notes outside repo. End with exact criterion/evidence labels.

criteria.text: Actual context and Pi tool behavior

result:
failure: result: Research incomplete; installed Pi 1.5.2 appears to provide the requested adapter natively, but public maintenance and alternatives could not be verified.
changed: none
checks: Read installed package documentation, changelog and type declarations; browser search attempt failed before navigation.
blockers: Browser relay error: “No browser has contacted this relay yet. If browse is installed, open that browser and run `npx @opencode/browse install` to pair it. Otherwise add browse from https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mfnicocicmmlkpjnaffgihfjhdgjkdjg.” Prior search/fetch required Exa credentials.
questions: Are repository CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md rules applicable to this read-only research? Public maintenance, community adoption, alternatives, and Windows support remain unverified.
notes:
- Facts: Installed Pi 1.5.2 registers MCP tools natively; default `codemode` exposure hides individual declarations and uses `searchTools()`; `deferred` loads schemas for direct calls via `tool_search`; `direct` declares them immediately. MCP calls pass through Pi hooks and permissions.
- Facts: Installed pi-mcp supports stdio, caller-provided pipes and Streamable HTTP, but not legacy HTTP+SSE. Codemode isolates scripts in QuickJS; injected tools retain their capabilities, and direct `execute()` wrappers can bypass hooks unless routed through the tool pipeline.
- Inference: Prefer evaluating Pi’s built-in integration before creating `pi-mcp-to-tool`; this is provisional, not a verified adoption decision. Confirm behavior in the locked 1.5.0 and current public release, compare maintenance/community evidence and test Windows before deciding.
evidence:
Candidate maintenance and provenance: Installed package metadata identifies Earendil Works and https://github.com/earendil-works/pi; installed pi-mcp changelog dates 1.5.1 to 2026-11-09 and 1.5.2 to 2026-11-10; independent public verification unavailable.
Actual context and Pi tool behavior: Installed `pi-coding-agent/dist/extensions/mcp/index.d.ts` and `pi-coding-agent/dist/core/mcp-servers.d.ts` document exposure, lazy discovery and hook behavior; installed `pi-codemode/README.md` documents sandbox and hook caveat.
Evidence-backed adoption or fallback: Built-in integration is a promising candidate, but no established alternative or fallback package can be selected without public evidence and version compatibility checks.
sources: Installed `@earendil-works/pi-mcp/README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `package.json`; `@earendil-works/pi-codemode/README.md`, `package.json`; public repository and example URLs identified but not fetched: https://github.com/earendil-works/pi and https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/tree/main/packages/agent/examples/mcp-codemode.
recommendation: Defer a new standalone package and final adoption decision until public research and Pi 1.5.0/Windows verification can be completed.
